title: 第13章 战寒阴地龙第14章 剑阁来人
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第十三章战寒阴地龙
“轰隆。”
一声轰鸣随之响起，只见不远处的岩壁骤然坍塌。
岩壁出现一个数丈高的窟窿。
“嗷呜。”
一声声低吼也随之自窟窿之中传来。
方羽等人面色一变，看着那窟窿，边上的山王西门山面色难看的开口说道。
“为何会来的这么快。”
周围众多矿奴和护卫，此时也是有些惧怕的看着那窟窿。
“哗啦啦.”
窟窿之中，碎石不断涌出。
“嗷呜。”
一声震天怒吼随之传来。
随后一只庞然大物，自那窟窿之中爆射而出。
“退后。”
陆玄看着那一物，当下厉声喝道。
接着陆玄身形一闪，其手中不知何时出现了一柄长枪，只见陆玄长枪裹挟着元力，一个横扫直接甩在那庞然大物之上。
那庞然大物，被陆玄这一枪扫中之后，瞬间朝着后方倒飞了出去。
最后直接撞在那岩壁之上。
众人看着这庞然大物，眼中都露出了惊惧之色。
方羽看着此物，自然异常的熟悉，不是寒阴地龙又是什么。
这一只寒阴地龙身长一丈有余，周身青色表皮，不断散发着恐怖的寒气。
“嗷呜。”
寒阴地龙被陆玄一枪扫飞之后，稳住身形，朝着陆玄发出一声嘶吼，那布满利齿的血盆大口不断涌出令人作呕的黏液。
在众人的目光下，只见后方的窟窿，涌出一只只散发着寒气的寒阴地龙。
这些寒阴地龙，出现之后，看到方羽等人，纷纷发出一声嘶吼。
“嗷呜。”
随后朝着方羽等人冲刺而来。
“动手。”
刚才跟陆玄交手的那只寒阴地龙，也随之朝着陆玄冲去，陆玄当下对着众人开口喝道。

Chapter Thirteen Fighting the Cold Yin Earth Dragon
"Boom."
A roar followed, and the rock wall not far away suddenly collapsed.
A hole several feet high appeared in the rock wall.
"Ouch."
...
A low roar also came from the cave.
Fang Yu and others' expressions changed, and when they looked at the hole, the mountain king Ximenshan on the side said with an ugly expression.
"Why did it come so fast?"
Many mine slaves and guards around were looking at the hole with some fear.
"Crash."
In the cave, rubble kept pouring out.
"Ouch."
A thundering roar followed.
"Boom."
Then a huge object burst out from the hole.
"Back off."
Lu Xuan looked at that thing and shouted sharply.
Then Lu Xuan's body flashed, and a spear appeared in his hand. Lu Xuan's spear was wrapped in Yuanli, and he swept directly on the huge thing.
"Bang."
The behemoth, after being hit by Lu Xuan's shot, instantly flew backwards.
Finally, it hit the rock wall directly.
Everyone looked at this behemoth with fear in their eyes.
Fang Yu looked at this thing and felt extremely familiar. If it wasn't Hanyin Earth Dragon, it was something else.
This Hanyin earth dragon is more than ten feet long, with a green skin all over its body, constantly exuding a terrifying cold air.
"Ouch."
After the Hanyin Earth Dragon was swept away by Lu Xuan with a shot, he stabilized his body and roared at Lu Xuan. The bloody mouth full of sharp teeth continued to gush out disgusting mucus.
"Swish..."
Under the gaze of everyone, they saw Hanyin Earth Dragons exuding cold energy pouring out of the hole in the back.
After these Hanyin earth dragons appeared, they roared when they saw Fang Yu and others.
"Ouch."
Then he sprinted towards Fang Yu and others.
"Do it."
The Hanyin Earth Dragon that had just fought with Lu Xuan also rushed towards Lu Xuan. Lu Xuan immediately shouted to everyone.
